answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 33241 Country: India Title: Is it a sunnah to do wudhu before going to sleep if we still have the wudhu of Isha? Question: Is it a sunnah to do wudhu before going to sleep if we still have the wudhu of Isha? Answer ID: 33241 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1188/989/B=1432) No, that wudhu is enough. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
